Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL3039007. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID. Return all columns including null SMILES.
